name: musesys-mcp
description: MuseSys/WooCommerce backend bridge for wegmansparts.com — orders, logistics, product requests, catalog, assets, exports.
long_description: stdio MCP server implementing UACP STATE_OF_THE_APP.md Part 2. Exposes 4 resources and 15 tools against the MuseSys WordPress backend with server-side validation gates (7-digit WO numbers, 3-digit zero-padded stores, strict YYYY-MM-DD dates, status normalization) and exponential backoff on 429/5xx. Credentials are collected at install time and passed as environment variables; nothing is written to disk.

wp_username.title: WordPress Username
wp_username.description: WP core username (required for musesys/v1 custom routes)

wp_app_password.title: WordPress Application Password
wp_app_password.description: WP Application Password for the user above
